query: For a 92‑year‑old man with ACS: among male inpatients aged 87–97, what is the 95th percentile of the 72‑hour lab instability score? For patients ≥P95 report mean LOS, in‑hospital mortality, and compare avg critical lab events per patient to general inpatients.
final_sql: SELECT percentile_cont(0.95) within GROUP (ORDER BY i.value) AS p95_value FROM male_inpatients i;
